'''Qiilura Traffic Control''' was the traffic authority in charge on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]]. They regulated incoming and outgoing traffic that passed through.<ref name="hc">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>
